recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, highly ornate composition featuring a central group of figures against a deep red background layered with intricate gold filigree and guilloche patterns. The style blends 19th-century engraving aesthetics with modern urban fashion and bold, dimensional typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized group of figures anchored by a bottom-center circular emblem
Contrast between high-saturation red background and metallic gold graphic elements
Symmetrical framing using baroque scrollwork and a thin gold border
Dynamic interaction between figures and large-scale display typography
coreInvariants: Deep crimson background with subtle textured damask patterns
Gold metallic sheen on all graphic and typographic elements
Heavy use of guilloche (fine line) patterns in the background
Strong chiaroscuro lighting on the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged in a pyramid formation, occupying the central 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A circular gold emblem at the bottom center featuring a stylized animal head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, move down through the central figures, and rest on the bottom banner text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and active; negative space is filled with intricate red-on-red patterns.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark, saturated reds and bright, reflective gold highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with Victorian flourishes
letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky stems with sharp, bracketed serifs
Integrated swashes and underlines that connect letters
3D beveling effect with internal gold gradients
Concave or arched baselines for display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders that turn into decorative scrolls
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Unified custom lettering style used for both top and bottom text blocks to maintain thematic consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy Victorian slab-serif aesthetic.
Necessary for the specific interlocking swashes and beveled depth.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep red textured background with intricate gold guilloche patterns and baroque filigree. Place a group of four figures in urban-baroque attire in a central pyramid formation with dramatic lighting. Add a circular gold emblem at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom beveled gold lettering in an arched formation at the top and within a decorative banner at the bottom. Ensure the text has a 3D metallic effect and sharp slab serifs.

verificationChecks: Is the gold texture consistent across all graphic elements?
Do the guilloche patterns appear as fine, engraved lines?
Is the central pyramid composition maintained?
Does the typography feel integrated with the scrollwork?

adjustableVariables: Degree of 3D beveling on the text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

avoid: Bright, primary colors other than red

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean, sharp edges on the gold filigree.
Ensure the red background has depth and isn't a flat fill.
Verify the typography is legible despite the ornate treatment.
Confirm the lighting on the subjects matches the dramatic tone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine Victorian engraving motifs with modern urban portraiture, unified by a strict red-and-gold color palette and heavy, beveled display typography.
